note: Owner-editable curated tag bundles. Seed slug (a genre/style) -> related cross-dimension slugs (business fit / daypart / energy) an admin usually adds with it, honoring avoidTagSlugs. Regenerate with scripts/generate-tag-packs-from-fit-rules.mjs (overwrites hand edits). All slugs are validated against the ACTIVE taxonomy at load + at suggestion time.

packs.explainHuman: Jazz fits boutique hotels, lobby listening, quality cafés, wine bars, business lunch, and elegant dinner — calm-to-medium energy listening spaces.
Smooth jazz works as unobtrusive background for hotels, cafés, and hospitality floors — lobby-friendly when energy stays refined.
Bossa nova suits cafés, restaurants, and hotels from morning through dinner — relaxed, polished atmosphere.
Afro-leaning grooves fit gyms (morning/afternoon energy), beach bars, young bars early evening, and tourist-heavy venues — medium/high energy; not ideal for desk-heavy office lunch contexts.
Deep house fits bars, lounges, and youthful restaurants — evening/night, medium/high energy; poor fit for quiet desk or clinical-feeling spaces.
Organic house suits hospitality floors and contemporary bars/restaurants — afternoon-through-night groove without harsh peaks.
Latin house adds movement for bars and evening dining — best when the room can handle rhythm and warmth.
Funk brings forward motion — retail brand moments, energetic dining, bars, or training floors; weaker for silent office cores.
Soul fits warm hospitality listening — cafés, restaurants, hotel bars — depth without sprinting the room.
Reggae/dub suits laid-back bars and beach-adjacent dining — easygoing or medium energy; rarely a match for sterile office environments.
Mediterranean pop fits Mediterranean-themed dining and hospitality — daytime-through-evening sunshine vibes.
Italian classics anchor trattoria and casual-upscale Italian dining — lunch and dinner storytelling playlists.
